# charly box authoring — programmatic box-manifest mutation

`candy/plugin-authoring` (`command:authoring`) serves the box-authoring verbs. They
mutate `box/<name>/charly.yml` safely instead of hand-editing YAML.

## Command tree

- `charly box set <path> <value>` — set a dot-path value (value parsed as YAML).
- `charly box add-candy <box> <candy>` — add a candy to a box's composition.
- `charly box rm-candy <box> <candy>` — remove a candy.
- `charly box write <path> [--content X | --from-stdin]` — write a relative path.
- `charly box cat <path>` — print a relative path.
- `charly box fetch` — fetch remote `@github` refs (host-coupled repo resolver over
  the reverse channel, `HostBuild("box-fetch-resolve")`).
- `charly box refresh` — refresh the project's resolved state.

`set`/`add-candy`/`rm-candy`/`write`/`cat` run entirely on `sdk/kit` + stdlib;
`fetch` and `refresh` reach the host-coupled repo resolver.

## When to use it

To change a box manifest programmatically (schema- and shape-aware), resolve remote
refs, or refresh a project's state.
